title: Warm Spring Russian Amazake Pancakes
description: Floral and springy Russian pancakes featuring amazake and coconut cream crack, perfect for a brunch mood, and friendly to egg-free diets.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, coconut sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the amazake, coconut cream, vanilla extract, and unsweetened almond milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Gently fold in the dried lavender buds.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes warm with a dollop of coconut cream crack on top.
